name: vk-messenger
description: Лёгкий и быстрый в любых условиях
author: VK Support <support@vk.com> (https://vk.com)

scripts.build: npm run lang && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/main && tsc --noEmit -p packages/preload && tsc --noEmit -p packages/renderer
scripts.compile: npm run build && electron-builder build --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.compile:dir: npm run build && electron-builder build --dir --config electron-builder.yml
